cheatNotes: _` Random Select (1P side)
- On the Character Select Screen, put the cursor on Upper-Left Corner or Bottom-Right Corner
- Select the random character with ^E / ^H for X-ISM
- Select the random character with ^F / ^I for A-ISM
- Select the random character with ^G / ^J for V-ISM
_` Random Select (2P side)
- On the Character Select Screen, put the cursor on Upper-Right Corner or Bottom-Left Corner
- Select the random character with ^E / ^H for X-ISM
- Select the random character with ^F / ^I for A-ISM
- Select the random character with ^G / ^J for V-ISM
_` Survival Mode
- After insert coins _O^U and press _S
- Needs a Light Blue Title Screen
_` Dramatic Battle Mode
- After insert coins _O^T and press _S
- Needs a Light Blue Title Screen
_` Final Battle Mode
- After select a ISM _O_S_+^E_+^I_+^G
- Needs a Light Blue Title Screen
_` Time Release and Title Color
- Cream                                                      Default Color
- Red (the time to unlock is unknown for now)                Unlock Secret Characters
- Green (the time to unlock is unknown for now)              Unlock Classic Mode
- Purple (the time to unlock is unknown for now)             Unlock Mazi Mode and Saikyou Mode
- Light Blue (the time to unlock is unknown for now)         Unlock Modes
_` Time Release and Title Color with Operator's Code
_` Red Color Title
- On the Test Mode, go to INPUT and press ^E^E_6^H^G_S_+^E on 1P side
- Exit the Test Mode
- After insert coins _O_S until the Character Select Screen appears and reset the machine
_` Green Color Title with Operator's Code
- On the Test Mode, go to COLOR and press ^H on 1P side, ^J on 2P side, ^F on 1P side, ^F on 2P side and _8_S_+^E on 1P side
- Exit the Test Mode
- After insert coins _O_S until the Character Select Screen appears and reset the machine
- Needs a Red Title Screen
_` Purple Color Title with Operator's Code
- On the Test Mode, go to GAME DATA and press _6_2 on 2P side, _4 on 1P side, ^J on 2P side, _6_2 on 1P side, ^E on 2P side and _8_S_+^E on 1P side
- Exit the Test Mode
- After insert coins _O_S until the Character Select Screen appears and reset the machine
- Needs a Green Title Screen
_` Light Blue Color Title with Operator's Code

- On the Test Mode, go to DOT CROSS HATCH and press _2 on 2P side, ^I on 1P side, _6 on 2P side, _2 on 1P side, _6^G on 2P side, _2 on 1P side, _4 on 2P side, ^F on 1P side, _6 on 2P side, _8_2 on 1P side, ^I on 2P side and ^H_S_+^E on 1P side
- Exit the Test Mode
- After insert coins _O_S until the Character Select Screen appears and reset the machine
- Needs a Purple Title Screen
